# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: watchfulness comes first. A soldier who isn't alert is a liability to his unit. Before we can stand firm, we must be awake—aware of the enemy's schemes, honest about our own weaknesses, and tuned to the Spirit's voice. Then comes the command to stand firm in the faith. Not drift. Not waver. Not compromise when culture pressures us to soften. Standing firm requires knowing what we believe and why, which means time in the Word isn't optional—it's ammunition. Finally, Paul says, "act like men, be strong." This isn't a call to bravado or self-reliance. The strength he commands is rooted in love (v. 14) and dependence on God. Biblical manhood is courageous and humble at once—firm in conviction, tender in love. Today, the storm will come in some form: temptation, discouragement, conflict. Don't shrink back. Watch. Stand. Be strong. Your King is watching, and He's worth fighting for.
## Daily Challenge
Do 3 rounds of 15 squats, pausing between rounds to pray: "Lord, make me watchful, firm, and strong today."
